annotations.title: Smart contract audit: security review of one contract in one call

description: Smart contract audit in one call: send a verified contract address (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon) or Solidity source and get, within a minute or two, findings by severity with function, line, exploit scenario and fix, the owner and upgrade keys read on chain, a score and a Markdown report. Automated (static checks plus AI reviewers), not a manual audit. Use before deploying, integrating with or buying into a contract. Price $1.00/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: Verified contract 0x address (a proxy is followed to its implementation). Send this or source

chain.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism or polygon; used with address

context.description: Optional notes for the reviewers, up to 1,000 characters: what the contract is for or what worries you

source.description: Solidity or Vyper source code, or the compiler's standard JSON input, up to 300,000 characters; POST it in a JSON body when it is long. Send this or address
